concepts.title: Reaction observations and balanced equations
concepts.scientific_exposition_seed: Atoms are conserved in chemical reactions; balanced equations count participating chemical entities, while observations alone do not establish product identity.
concepts.scientific_conditions: Declare actual chemical species, model validity, material phases and what observations cannot establish.
